org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model

Class CcdFrame

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model.CcdFrame

  • @Entity
public class CcdFrame
extends Object
    Entity class representing the CcdFrame database table. The class also contains a number of @Transient fields used to contain information about the frame, but that is not stored in the database. These include rawFrame, correctedFrame, pupilMaskType and false color png byte array.

    smichaels
